summary: Israel is told to destroy the figured stones of Canaan. The same word describes what takes shape in a person’s heart.

senses.definition: A stone bearing a figure can become an object before which people bow. Psalm 73 uses the plural for the designs of the heart.

words.gloss: seat of understanding, possibly a bird

senses.gloss: seat of understanding, possibly a bird
senses.definition: In Yahweh’s questions to Job it receives understanding. The parallel with wisdom fixes the gift more securely than the identity of its recipient.
Isaiah sets these objects of delight beside the ships of Tarshish. The single use leaves the precise object uncertain.

note: The initial mem belongs to the noun pattern in מַשְׂכִּית. Compare the related forms proposed for sight, though Job 38:36 and Isa 2:16 are both obscure. The knife in Pro 23:2 has a separate spelling שׂכין.
